h1: Heart of Harmony on Hosur Road: How Highway, Metro and Lifestyle Access Work Together

blocks.text: Heart of Harmony is located at Kudlu Gate on Hosur Main Road (NH48), Bengaluru 560068 — the junction where highway access, metro connectivity, and South Bengaluru’s best lifestyle hubs converge. The project is 400 metres from Kudlu Gate Metro Station (Yellow Line), 10 minutes by road from Silk Board junction, and within 15 minutes of Koramangala, HSR Layout, BTM Layout, and Electronic City.

What makes this address genuinely distinctive is not any single factor — it is how all three work together. CKPC Heart of Harmony calls this the Triad of Delight: the simultaneous advantage of highway access, metro proximity, and lifestyle convenience in one address on Hosur Main Road.
When Location Goes Beyond Pin Codes

A good location is often defined by one factor: proximity to work, access to infrastructure, or lifestyle convenience. But the most valuable locations bring all three together. At Heart of Harmony, this balance is defined through a triad of connectivity, accessibility, and lifestyle, creating a living experience that is not just convenient but consistently efficient in everyday life.
Most luxury projects on Hosur Road can claim one or two of these advantages. Heart of Harmony is positioned at the exact micro-location — Kudlu Gate — where all three converge in a single address.
Metro Connectivity: 400 Metres from Seamless Mobility

Being located just 400 metres from Kudlu Gate Metro Station places daily commute within easy reach. This proximity reduces dependence on road travel, offering a faster and more predictable way to move across the city. For working professionals, this means shorter commutes. For families, it adds a layer of convenience, making the city more accessible without the stress of traffic.

The Yellow Line (Namma Metro Phase 2) connects Kudlu Gate to Jayadeva Hospital (interchange with the Green Line), Dairy Circle (Bannerghatta Road access), and Bommasandra deep in Electronic City — covering the most important commute destinations for residents in this corridor without requiring road travel.
NH48 Access: Direct Connection to Key Corridors

Positioned right on NH48 (Hosur Main Road), Heart of Harmony benefits from direct connectivity to major parts of Bengaluru. Whether accessing Electronic City, the Outer Ring Road, or other key business districts, the highway ensures smooth travel routes. This kind of arterial connectivity is critical not just for reducing travel time, but for ensuring that daily movement remains efficient even as the city grows.

The Electronic City Expressway — Bengaluru’s first elevated urban expressway — runs along this corridor, providing a significantly faster alternative to the Hosur Road service road during peak hours. For residents travelling south toward Electronic City Phase 1 and 2, the expressway reduces a potentially 30-minute commute to under 15 minutes off-peak.
Close to Lifestyle Hubs: Everyday Convenience, Minutes Away

Beyond connectivity, the location places residents minutes away from established lifestyle hubs like Koramangala, HSR Layout, and BTM. These areas offer a well-developed ecosystem of restaurants, retail, healthcare, and social infrastructure, making it easier to access everything you need without long travel times. It ensures that city life is equally accessible to workplaces.

Proximity to Narayana Health City (Bommasandra, ~5 km), Vega City Mall (BTM Layout, ~5 km), VIBGYOR High School (HSR Layout, ~5 km), and the growing retail and dining strip on Hosur Main Road itself means everyday convenience — not just commute convenience — is built into the address.
Conclusion: A Location That Simplifies Daily Life

The Triad of Delight is ultimately about balance, bringing together mobility, access, and lifestyle into one cohesive advantage. With metro connectivity, highway access, and proximity to key urban hubs, Heart of Harmony offers a location that works across multiple dimensions. It is not just well-connected — it is designed to make everyday living simpler, faster, and more complete.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: Where is Heart of Harmony located?
items.a: Heart of Harmony is located at Kudlu Gate on Hosur Main Road (NH48), Bengaluru 560068. It is 400 metres from Kudlu Gate Metro Station on the Yellow Line and 10 minutes by road from Silk Board junction. RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .

items.q: How far is Heart of Harmony from Silk Board?
items.a: Heart of Harmony on Hosur Main Road is approximately 5–6 km from Silk Board Junction — about 10–15 minutes by road off-peak. During peak hours, the distance and time may vary based on traffic on Hosur Main Road.

items.q: How far is Heart of Harmony from Koramangala?
items.a: Heart of Harmony is approximately 9 km from Koramangala 1st Block — about 25–30 minutes by road off-peak. The Yellow Line metro provides an alternative non-road route connecting Kudlu Gate toward the central parts of South Bengaluru.

items.q: How far is Heart of Harmony from HSR Layout?
items.a: Heart of Harmony is approximately 6 km from HSR Layout town centre — about 15–20 minutes by road off-peak via Hosur Main Road.

items.q: How far is Heart of Harmony from Electronic City?
items.a: Heart of Harmony is approximately 4–6 km from Electronic City Phase 1 and 2 — about 10–20 minutes off-peak via Hosur Main Road. The Electronic City Expressway (elevated road) significantly reduces commute time during peak hours.

items.q: Is there a metro station near Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Yes. Kudlu Gate Metro Station on the Yellow Line (Namma Metro Phase 2) is just 400 metres from Heart of Harmony — approximately a 5-minute walk. The Yellow Line connects to Jayadeva Hospital (interchange with Green Line), Dairy Circle, and Bommasandra (Electronic City).

items.q: What is the address of Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony, Hosur Main Road (NH48), Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru, Karnataka – 560068. RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .. Phone: +91 76499 99586 .

items.q: What is the Triad of Delight at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: The Triad of Delight refers to Heart of Harmony’s three-way connectivity advantage: (1) direct highway access on NH48, (2) 400 metres from Kudlu Gate Metro Station (Yellow Line), and (3) proximity to South Bengaluru’s lifestyle hubs including Koramangala, HSR Layout, and BTM Layout. Together these three create an address where work, commute, and lifestyle access are all optimised.

items.q: What lifestyle hubs are near Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Koramangala (~9 km, 25–30 mins), HSR Layout (~6 km, 15–20 mins), BTM Layout (~7 km, 20–25 mins), Electronic City (~4–6 km, 10–20 mins), and Silk Board junction (~5–6 km, 10–15 mins) are all within easy reach from Heart of Harmony at Kudlu Gate on Hosur Road.

items.q: Is Heart of Harmony on Hosur Road or Hosur Main Road?
items.a: Heart of Harmony is located on Hosur Main Road (also called NH48 or National Highway 48, colloquially referred to as Hosur Road), at the Kudlu Gate junction in South Bengaluru — Karnataka 560068.
